notes: Dark, near-monochrome Inter system with ONE sky-blue accent (#5caeff = rgb(92,174,255), the page's single hue, used 452x as color AND border). Normalized: base weight is 400 (961 of 994 nodes; 500/600/700 are <4%) — hierarchy is SCALE not weight. Two-cluster type ramp: UI 12/14/16/18/24px + display 48/56/96px; body 16->H1 96 is ~6x; in-between sizes dropped as one-offs. Tracking is normal everywhere except 48px+ which tightens to -1.2/-1.4px. Surfaces and borders are white-at-alpha (0.05/0.10/0.15) over black, not separate gray tokens — derive elevation from fg-alpha. radius dominant 24px (51x) on cards/panels, full-pill on chips, 12px on inputs/code; the raw 3.35544e+07px value is the pill (collapsed to 9999px). NO box-shadow anywhere (elevation is borders + accent glow). One brand gradient: sky-blue->white logo sweep. Section spacing is moderate (32px padding, 16px gap) — docs-adjacent, not cathedral marketing spacing. Motion: dominant transition is BARE 0.3s ease (248x) + 0.2s ease (46x) — not a tuned curve (weaker than Attio/Linear's cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1)); a few nodes use Material cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1). The 60000ms/2000ms durations are the marquee/spinner loops. Light mode supported but distilled as dark (captured default).
